definitions.explanation: The very edge or boundary of something physical — the point where one thing ends and another begins.
A crucial point in time, especially a critical juncture or the moment just before something happens. Often used in the pattern ~の{際|きわ} or {土壇場|どたんば}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{水|みず}{際|ぎわ}→水際：10686_mizugiwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
⟦{窓|まど}{際|ぎわ}→窓際：08400_madogiwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}った→座る：00757_suwaru⟧。
examples.english: I sat in a seat by the window.

examples.japanese: ⟦{崖|がけ}→崖：05391_gake⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{際|きわ}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{近|ちか}づく→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧だ。
examples.english: It's dangerous to approach the edge of the cliff.
On the verge of death, they called for their family.

examples.japanese: ⟦ぎりぎり→ぎりぎり：05166_girigiri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{際|きわ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{間|ま}に{合|あ}った→間に合う：01142_maniau⟧。
examples.english: We made it at the very last moment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{際|きわ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{逆転|ぎゃくてん}→逆転：06839_gyakuten⟧⟦ゴール→ゴール：03845_gooru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}め→決める：00858_kimeru⟧、⟦{優勝|ゆうしょう}→優勝：03647_yuushou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つかんだ。
examples.english: They scored a comeback goal at the critical moment and clinched the championship.

notes:
Refers to the very edge of something, both physical and temporal. In compounds, the reading often becomes ぎわ (voicing, rendaku).

COMMON COMPOUNDS (with ぎわ):
- ⟦{水際|みずぎわ}→水際：10686_mizugiwa⟧ — water's edge; border control measures
- ⟦{窓際|まどぎわ}→窓際：08400_madogiwa⟧ — by the window
- ⟦{瀬戸際|せとぎわ}→瀬戸際：10554_setogiwa⟧ — brink, critical moment
- ⟦{間際|まぎわ}→間際：14564_magiwa⟧ — just before, on the verge of
- {引|ひ}き{際|ぎわ} — time to withdraw, knowing when to quit
- ⟦{別|わか}れ{際|ぎわ}→別れ際：07471_wakaregiwa⟧ — moment of parting

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{死|し}→死：13248_shi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{際|きわ} — the verge of death, deathbed
- {際|きわ}どい — borderline, risky, risque
- ⟦{際立|きわだ}つ→際立つ：07832_kiwadatsu⟧ — to stand out, to be conspicuous

DIFFERENT READINGS OF {際|きわ}:
- {際|きわ} — edge, verge (this entry)
- ⟦{際|さい}→際：02819_sai⟧ — occasion, time when (different word, as in ⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧, ⟦{実際|じっさい}→実際：02502_jissai⟧)
